The existing failure shows a mismatch between the registered signature and the call: the binding registered conv_transpose2d_forward with only six parameters (three Tensors and three ints), but model_new.py passes nine arguments (including stride_h, stride_w, padding_h, padding_w, output_padding_h, output_padding_w). This causes the TypeError. The binding must define conv_transpose2d_forward with the full parameter list matching the launcher: input, weight, bias, stride_h, stride_w, padding_h, padding_w, output_padding_h, output_padding_w. Registering the schema with that exact signature will allow the torch.ops call to succeed.

custom_ops.cu launcher expects all these integer parameters, and the binding wrapper must pass them through.
The previous binding likely used a shorter schema, causing the argument mismatch. The fix is to register the full signature in TORCH_LIBRARY and keep the wrapper function signature accordingly.
